obfuscation_indicators: excluding the effect of foreign currency fluctuations
risk_summary: The disclosure quantifies COVID-19 impacts, sales declines, impairment charges, store damage, and reduced ROIC, indicating meaningful operating and execution risk. Forward-looking exposure remains uncertain because the duration and financial effects of disruptions, closures, capacity limits, and trade issues cannot be reasonably estimated. Extensive non-GAAP and constant-currency measures may reduce comparability with GAAP results, although reconciliations are referenced.
